title: William S NDE 95
content:
I was involved in a motorbike accident and I remember lying in the field with a terrible pain in my back. I first checked that I could move my limbs (I could) and the next thing I knew, I was in a kind of glass lift. I waited in the lift until the door opened and then stepped out. The area I arrived in seemed cubic, all white and very relaxing. It was like a greeting area. I looked to my left and there were people standing in a line - infants to adults of all ages, and there was even a tree there. I looked in front of me and towards the corner was someone in a white robe and to his side was a soldier kneeling with a weapon. I noticed the soldier was wearing today's modern dress. In between them, was a bright light and I suddenly realized where I was. I remembered programs where people had said, “Don't go to the light,” which I wasn't about to do, but I didn't know what else to do. I thought, “Do I choose a body from here to go back in?” Then suddenly, I heard my name being called from a corner. I looked and there was a swirling cloud with something like lightning mixed in. I thought, “I want to go back to my wife,” so I went to where my name was being called and the calling became louder. Then I heard, “We have VF [Ventricular Fibrillation], which was [said] in German. I gasped for breath and opened my eyes to see the emergency doctor looking down at me, and the paramedic cutting my leathers. I then went into a coma with terrible nightmares.

arrival.other_being_detail: Someone in a white robe; a soldier kneeling with a weapon wearing modern dress; people standing in a line (infants to adults).

environment.environment_other_detail: Cubic area, all white, very relaxing; described as a 'greeting area'; a tree was present.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Transitional 'glass lift'; 'greeting area' with line of people (infants to adults), tree; white-robed figure; soldier kneeling with weapon; swirling cloud with lightning; heard medical staff say 'We have VF' (in German).
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Accident/pain → sudden transition into 'glass lift' → arrival in white cubic 'greeting area' with beings and bright light → heard name called from corner and moved toward it → heard 'We have VF' and returned to body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Transition described as being in a 'glass lift' that opened into a white cubic 'greeting area' with a line of people (infants to adults) and a tree; presence of a modern-dressed kneeling soldier with a weapon; swirling cloud with lightning calling his name; post-return coma with terrible nightmares.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Don't go to the light,” “Do I choose a body from here to go back in?” “I want to go back to my wife,” “We have VF [Ventricular Fibrillation]”
